businesses.business: secure digital fax and healthcare information exchange software

offering_description.value: Provides cloud-based secure digital fax (eFax) and document exchange services to businesses, healthcare providers and consumers. Also sells healthcare interoperability and secure messaging software (Clarus, Jfax, Consensus Signal). Delivered as subscription cloud services.
